data.name: Hriday
data.long_meaning: Hriday is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘hridaya’ meaning ‘heart, mind, soul.’ In Hinduism, the heart is considered the seat of emotions, intelligence, and the soul. The name Hriday is thus imbued with spiritual significance, symbolizing deep wisdom, courage, and compassion.

in_sanskrit.name: हृदय
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The seat of emotions and intellect; the center of life.

in_hindi.name: हृदय
in_hindi.long_meaning: हेर्द (Hērd) - दय (Day) ; हृदय का नाम है जिसका सिवाल है जिससे हम जीवन के साथ जीते हैं। यह दिल का नाम है जो आत्मा को समझना और सही स्वाभाविक रिश्ते बनाना होता है।

in_tamil.name: ஹ்ரிதய்
in_tamil.long_meaning: ஹிர் (Hir) - தய் (Day) ; ஹஃர்தையால் ஒவ்வோ உலகில் ஒப்பிய ஓர் ஒப்பின் அவசியம் இருக்கிறது. இது இந்த ஜிஜ்மப் மேல் அழித்து உடல்களைக் குடிக்கு உங்கள் வாழ்வுகளைக் கேட்பது.

in_telugu.name: హ్రిదయ
in_telugu.long_meaning: హిర్ (Hir) - దయ్ (Day) ; హృదైయ ఆయోజ్జయేళ్ళో అయినే జీవితే దేశముదే పోయేదు. ఇదు అదే జీవితే అదే పోయేదు.

vedic_reference.note: Hridayam in Vedas is a term that refers to the heart as the center of life and emotions. It is also used metaphorically to denote the seat of intellect and the source of spiritual wisdom.

data.cultural_impact: The name Hriday is a popular one in Hindu traditions, often found in Hindu mythology and folklore. It is not uncommon to encounter characters or deities with this name, adding to its cultural significance.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Hriday holds great spiritual significance as it signifies the deepest part of one's being, encompassing the emotional, intellectual, and spiritual self. In Hinduism, the heart is the center of one's essential consciousness, and individuals may seek to cultivate and awaken this inner wisdom to lead a more enlightened life.

historical_references.reference: Hridayamaharaj was a famous Jain Tirthankara, who is regarded as the 24th Tirthankara in the present era. His symbol is the Horse. He is believed to have attained Kaivalya around 148 BC in Magadh Desh, Bihar, India.

Hridaya Raja Vibudhakala, a famous king of the Western Chalukya Empire in India, ruled from 1068 to 1118 AD. He is known for his patronage of arts and architecture, particularly the Hoysala style, and his military conquests.

name_in_real_life.story: Lakshmi Hriday, a teacher in Chennai, India, shares that their name Hriday meaning "Heart, Mind, Soul" has been a constant source of inspiration, motivating them to follow Hindu values and serve their community.

data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Hriday in Sanskrit means 'heart'. It symbolizes the innermost part of an individual, where emotions, intelligence, and consciousness converge. It is the dwelling place of the Atman (soul) and the point of connection between the physical and spiritual realms.
